question: What radiation, scan range, step size and scan speed were used for powder X-ray diffraction of the sodium chlorate crystals?
expect: Cu K-alpha; 2-100 degrees 2-theta; 0.01 degree steps; 20 degrees/min (Characterization Techniques)
